explanation: The worked solution confirms e: r′=2cos(4θ)/sqrt(1+sin(4θ)), so r²+(r′)²=1+sin(4θ)+4(1−sin(4θ))=5−3sin(4θ). Apply the arc-length formula piecewise at the isolated zeros of r. Options a and b have equal integral values by periodic shifts, but e directly gives the derived arc-length element.
